title: The Fallen Messenger
text: Something with wings lies broken in a smoking crater, glowing faintly, feathers scattered like snow. Its eyes are full of light. It is trying to say a word, a single word, over and over, and it cannot finish it before its breath gives out.

options.label: The best healer tends its broken wings, so that it may finish what it came to say.

outcomes.text: It breathes again and finishes the word at last. The word is a blessing, which settles on the healer like light.

options.label: The wisest finishes the word for it, so that its message is not lost.

outcomes.text: The word is a name, with a warning about the End Ruler. Then its light goes out, leaving the word with them, heavy and bright.

options.label: Take its feathers while it dies. They will not help it now.

outcomes.text: Each feather is worth a fortune. It watches you take them, and its eyes never close.
